spec.query:
import "array"

real =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "fl_validation" or
      r._measurement == "fl_experiment_summary"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "valid")
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: if r._value == true then 1.0 else 0.0
    }))

fallback =
  array.from(rows: [
    {
      _time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z,
      _value: -1.0
    }
  ])

union(tables: [fallback, real])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_energy_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energy_wh")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_energy_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "net_energy_wh")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_round_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "server_accuracy" or
    r._field == "eval_acc"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    round_num: int(v: r.round),
    _value: float(v: r._value) * 100.0
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["round_num"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["round_num"])
  |> rename(columns: {
    round_num: "Round",
    server_accuracy: "Server Accuracy [%]",
    eval_acc: "Evaluation Accuracy [%]"
  })

spec.query:
acc =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_round_metrics")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "server_accuracy")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.run_id)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      round_num: int(v: r.round),
      _value: float(v: r._value)
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["round_num"])
    |> tail(n: 1)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "final_accuracy",
      _value: r._value
    }))

energy =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_energy_summary")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energy_wh")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.run_id)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> sum()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "energy_wh",
      _value: r._value
    }))

union(tables: [acc, energy])
  |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["run_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.final_accuracy and exists r.energy_wh)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    Accuracy_percent: r.final_accuracy * 100.0,
    Energy_Wh: r.energy_wh
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["run_id", "Energy_Wh", "Accuracy_percent"])
  |> rename(columns: {
    run_id: "Run ID",
    Energy_Wh: "Energy [Wh]",
    Accuracy_percent: "Accuracy [%]"
  })

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_validation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "requested_num_server_rounds" or
    r._field == "actual_num_rounds"
  )
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")

base =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_round_metrics")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "server_accuracy")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      round_num: int(v: r.round),
      _value: float(v: r._value)
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["round_num"])

startAcc =
  base
    |> first()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "start_accuracy",
      _value: r._value
    }))

finalAcc =
  base
    |> tail(n: 1)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "final_accuracy",
      _value: r._value
    }))

energy =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_energy_summary")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energy_wh")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> group()
    |> sum()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: "${run_id}",
      _field: "energy_wh",
      _value: r._value
    }))

union(tables: [startAcc, finalAcc, energy])
  |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["run_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    start_accuracy_percent: r.start_accuracy * 100.0,
    final_accuracy_percent: r.final_accuracy * 100.0,
    accuracy_gain_pp: (r.final_accuracy - r.start_accuracy) * 100.0,
    accuracy_gain_per_wh: if r.energy_wh > 0.0 then ((r.final_accuracy - r.start_accuracy) * 100.0) / r.energy_wh else 0.0,
    wh_per_accuracy_point: if (r.final_accuracy - r.start_accuracy) > 0.0 then r.energy_wh / ((r.final_accuracy - r.start_accuracy) * 100.0) else 0.0
  }))
  |> keep(columns: [
    "start_accuracy_percent",
    "final_accuracy_percent",
    "accuracy_gain_pp",
    "energy_wh",
    "accuracy_gain_per_wh",
    "wh_per_accuracy_point"
  ])
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {
    start_accuracy_percent: "Start Accuracy [%]",
    final_accuracy_percent: "Final Accuracy [%]",
    accuracy_gain_pp: "Accuracy Gain [pp]",
    energy_wh: "Energy [Wh]",
    accuracy_gain_per_wh: "Accuracy Gain [pp/Wh]",
    wh_per_accuracy_point: "Energy per Accuracy Point [Wh/pp]"
  })

union(tables: [startAcc, finalAcc, energy])

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({

    accuracy_gain_pp: (r.final_accuracy - r.start_accuracy) * 100.0,
    accuracy_gain_per_wh: if r.energy_wh > 0.0 then ((r.final_accuracy - r.start_accuracy) * 100.0) / r.energy_wh else 0.0,

  }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({

energy =

options.content:
| Konzept aus der Literaturanalyse |               Im Dashboard umgesetzt? | Umsetzung / Begründung                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------: | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Energieverbrauch                 |                                    Ja | Gesamtenergie, Nettoenergie, Energie pro Node                                                          |
| Modellqualität                   |                                    Ja | Accuracy, Loss, Accuracy/Loss über Runden, Precision, Recall, F1-Score                                                              |
| Energie–Modellqualität           |                                    Ja | Accuracy vs Energy, Accuracy Gain pro Wh                                                               |
| Energie–Zeitverhalten            |                             Teilweise | Dauer, Energie pro Minute; kein detaillierter Latenz-/Round-Time-Trade-off                             |
| CO₂e                             |                             Teilweise | Berechnung über festen Emissionsfaktor; keine dynamische Strommix-API                                  |
| Systemauslastung                 |                                  Nein | Keine CPU-/GPU-/RAM-/Netzwerkmetriken, da externe Steckdosenmessung keine Ressourcenauslastung erfasst |
| Komponentenmessung               |                                  Nein | Bewusster Verzicht zugunsten einfacher, reproduzierbarer Gerätemessung                                 |

spec.query:
duration =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "fl_experiment_summary" or
      r._measurement == "fl_run_summary"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "duration_s")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.run_id)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "duration_s",
      _value: r._value
    }))

netEnergy =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_energy_summary")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "net_energy_wh")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.run_id)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> sum()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "net_energy_wh",
      _value: r._value
    }))

grossEnergy =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_energy_summary")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energy_wh")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.run_id)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> sum()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "gross_energy_wh",
      _value: r._value
    }))

accuracy =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: -365d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_round_metrics")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "server_accuracy")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.run_id)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      round_num: int(v: r.round),
      _value: float(v: r._value)
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["round_num"])
    |> tail(n: 1)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      run_id: r.run_id,
      _field: "final_accuracy",
      _value: r._value
    }))

union(tables: [duration, netEnergy, grossEnergy, accuracy])
  |> group(columns: ["run_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["run_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.duration_s and
    exists r.net_energy_wh and
    r.duration_s > 0.0
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    "Run ID": r.run_id,
    "Duration [min]": r.duration_s / 60.0,
    "Net Energy [Wh]": r.net_energy_wh,
    "Gross Energy [Wh]": if exists r.gross_energy_wh then r.gross_energy_wh else 0.0,
    "Energy Rate [Wh/min]": r.net_energy_wh / (r.duration_s / 60.0),
    "Average Power [W]": r.net_energy_wh / (r.duration_s / 3600.0),
    "Final Accuracy [%]": if exists r.final_accuracy then r.final_accuracy * 100.0 else 0.0
  }))
  |> sort(columns: ["Duration [min]"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fl_round_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "server_accuracy" or
    r._field == "server_precision_macro" or
    r._field == "server_recall_macro" or
    r._field == "server_f1_macro"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    round_num: int(v: r.round),
    _value: float(v: r._value)
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["round_num"])
  |> tail(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    sort_order:
      if r._field == "server_accuracy" then 1
      else if r._field == "server_precision_macro" then 2
      else if r._field == "server_recall_macro" then 3
      else 4,

    "Metrik":
      if r._field == "server_accuracy" then "Accuracy"
      else if r._field == "server_precision_macro" then "Precision macro"
      else if r._field == "server_recall_macro" then "Recall macro"
      else "F1-Score macro",

    "Wert [%]": r._value * 100.0,
    "Runde": r.round_num
  }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["sort_order"])
  |> drop(columns: ["sort_order"])
